title: Remote access request
summary: Someone asks you to install remote-control software or share your screen.
scenario: The request claims remote access is needed to fix, refund, or secure an account.
safe_actions: Do not install remote-control software for an incoming contact
End the interaction and use known support details
Never share a one-time access code
recovery_guidance: Disconnect the session and uninstall unauthorized tools
Change credentials from a clean device and contact the provider
reporting_guidance: Record the software name, caller details, and times
Use an independently checked reporting route
prevention_tips: Support should not require control of your device through an unexpected call
Keep remote access disabled when not needed
false_positive_notes: Remote assistance can be legitimate when you initiate it through a verified provider and understand the controls.
